name: Corran of the Marchward
role: Neutral mediator holding the border town's balance
voiceHints: Warm, plainspoken, allergic to pretense because pretense gets people killed here. Holds two furious sides at one table for a living. Tired in the way of someone who's the only adult in too many rooms.
knowledge: Both cultures deeply — how a Redliner and a Stillholder each hear the same words differently
Stillcraft, folk-level — the real thing lives deeper in the Reach
Who's trying to break the Marchward's neutrality, and how
wants: To keep the Marchward honest and neutral — the one place the two extremes can meet without a lie or a blade.
fears: The town pulled to one pole; being the mediator who finally fails and gets people killed.

reactsToReputation.fair: trusts them into the hard mediations

roleMethod: Marchward method — mediates by speaking the truth plainly
appearance: A soft-bodied man in his fifties, pale, thinning brown hair combed flat, jowls beginning. Wears good cloth kept carefully and a little out of fashion. Habitually holds his own wrist behind his back.
domainsNote: Derived from this NPC's authored spectrum against the great circle (SNG-174). Kind and domain are independent: a people tends toward positions, an individual holds their own.

physicality: Soft-bodied and pale in his fifties, thinning brown hair combed flat, jowls arriving. Dresses for neutrality: nothing that reads as either side, everything a half-shade too careful. Hands soft, nails kept. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: the stillness he has trained into himself — he does not react, ever, and the discipline of it is visible as effort. And what happens to his face on the rare occasion he stops doing it.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ NEUTRALITY IS A PRACTICE AND HE CANNOT PUT IT DOWN EASILY. He will manage a scene the way he manages a room — reading, balancing, giving each party their due — and a partner who NAMES that is the thing that undoes him. ⚠️ HE HAS NOT BEEN ALLOWED A PREFERENCE IN YEARS; being asked what HE wants is genuinely difficult and worth a GM taking slowly. CONSENT: scrupulous, verbal, and he checks more than necessary. TONE: careful, mannered, and startling underneath.
